_doc: plots: the kinds of plot a building may stand on (a building of the yard may stand on a ring plot too, round 9; one with lots_only stands there alone: the scrap yard, the one building of the ring, round 11 dropped the orchard and the cistern). scrap is paid when it is ordered, work is builder-hours at the base rate. max: how many may stand (sites count), never more than the plots it could stand on: the compound has seven, five in the yard and two on the wall, so the watchtower is at most two and the bunk house two. requires: a building that must already stand. effects: a flat map of numbers read through sim.build.bonus(key) (the sum over the standing buildings) and sim.build.factor(key) (the product): seats_<station id> (more seats at a station), unlocks_station is carried by stations.json (requires), garden_base (food at each dawn), craft_mult (the workbench's scrap an hour), ammo_per_scrap, beds (beds for patients), housing (people the compound sleeps, round 7), morale (a steady mood bonus), night_reach_mult (the guns' reach by night), blackout_proof (1: a blackout costs no aim), reach_bonus and reach_radius (tiles of reach for people near the building), boon_mult and threat_mult (the radio's cards), radio_range (round 7).

buildings.name: Salvage bench
buildings.blurb: Sorts the yard's junk into scrap: a new job for two, 0.4 scrap an hour each.

buildings.name: Greenhouse beds
buildings.blurb: More beds for the garden: two more gardeners, and a little more food each dawn.

buildings.name: Workshop
buildings.blurb: A proper workshop: a third seat at the bench, quicker work and one more round from every scrap.

buildings.name: Bunk house
buildings.blurb: Four proper beds: the hurt rest in them, the crew sleeps better, and four more can be housed.

buildings.name: Floodlights
buildings.blurb: A generator and lamps: the guns reach further by night and a blackout costs no aim.

buildings.name: Watchtower
buildings.blurb: A tower on the wall: shooters near it reach three tiles further.

buildings.name: Radio mast
buildings.blurb: A taller mast: better news on the radio, fewer bad surprises, and a longer reach for later.

buildings.name: Scrap yard
buildings.blurb: A heap of the street's wrecks, picked over by whoever has a spare hour: a little scrap every dawn.
